title: [VisualLook V2] Select two actual visual Looks on one reusable component
body:
Parent #5366.

## Scope
Provide bounded compact vs spacious (and independent palette) selection over same Todo/Face component using current Host-admitted expression policy.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Same checked component/Face IDs and available actions in both.
- [ ] Missing Look or unsupported feature falls back honestly.
- [ ] Style resources and selection inspectable.

## Stop line
Do not smuggle CSS parsing into ConduitOS core.

Contract #5368, separation #5364, component #5365. CSS browser implementation #5379 is separate.

One focused PR should carry needed safety regressions and identify proof class.
